Overview

A closer look

TrustBrain™ is nTrust.ai’s autonomous cyber operations and reasoning copilot. Designed for enterprise SecOps, CISOs, and site reliability teams, TrustBrain synthesizes high-velocity security findings into structured remediation actions.

By bridging TrustGuard’s drift telemetry, TokenShield’s AI privacy controls, and TrustAudit’s sovereign compliance records, TrustBrain acts as the central brain across the entire nTrust cyber mesh.

Every automated operation is protected by a strict Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gate and cryptographic rollback baseline, guaranteeing zero accidental infrastructure outages.

Capabilities

What you get

🧠

Dual-Agent Reasoning Mesh

Autonomous analyzer agents parse complex multi-vector alerts while governor agents enforce mathematical safety boundaries.

Quantitative Blast Radius

Governor HITL Approval Gate

Deterministic 1-Click Rollback
